title: [Bug]: Latest chat session permanently lost from /chat list after using gemini --resume

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides clear reproduction steps, environment details, and expected vs actual behavior regarding session persistence when using gemini --resume.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Fixing this bug requires handling session metadata updates and session retention cleanup logic across both packages/cli and packages/core.

summary.problem: Using gemini --resume causes the most recent chat session to permanently disappear from the /chat list on subsequent normal launches.
summary.root_cause: When a session is resumed, ChatRecordingService appends metadata updates ($set) to the session file. During subsequent normal startup, getAllSessionFiles and cleanupExpiredSessions fail to correctly recognize the updated metadata or evaluate the session as non-resumable/corrupted, causing automatic session cleanup to delete or exclude the session file.
summary.context: Automatic session retention cleanup runs at CLI startup. Resuming a session appends metadata records to the session file, which must be correctly handled when parsing session records during cleanup and session listing.

steps: Ensure loadConversationRecord in packages/core/src/services/chatRecordingService.ts correctly preserves hasResumableContent and metadata when processing $set metadata update records appended during session resumption.
Update getAllSessionFiles in packages/cli/src/utils/sessionUtils.ts to correctly recognize and preserve resumed session records without filtering them out as non-resumable.
Ensure cleanupExpiredSessions in packages/cli/src/utils/sessionCleanup.ts does not treat valid resumed session files as corrupted or eligible for deletion on normal CLI startup.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Resumed chat sessions persist across subsequent normal CLI launches and remain visible in the /chat session list.
verification_steps: Create a chat session and save it.
Resume the chat session using resolveSessionId with --resume and update metadata via ChatRecordingService.
Run cleanupExpiredSessions on a subsequent simulated normal launch with a new session ID.
Verify that the resumed session file is not deleted and remains accessible in getAllSessionFiles.
